thread:
maria: quick sync — we need to finalize how billing attribution keys flow through the trace envelope vs spans. multi-currency customers surfaced this gap.

ashok: short version: we should surface a single "billing namespace" on the envelope for joins + allow span-level overrides for exceptional cases.

priya: agree. envelope-first simplifies aggregation and reduces heavy span scans in billing. main risk is masking per-span overrides (some clients set currency on specific spans).

leo: ops note: routing and shard keys already depend on envelope attrs. adding envelope.billing_currency will slightly change partitioning. we should measure skew on canary before wide rollout.

sasha: data integrity: do NOT convert to USD at ingest. store raw amount + currency (ISO codes) and do FX conversion in billing pipeline with archived rates. keeps audits easy.

maria: proposed decision: 1) require envelope.billing_key + envelope.primary_currency (ISO-4217 uppercase). 2) allow span.currency override. 3) do not canonicalize at ingest. 4) validator normalizes codes (strip symbols, uppercase) and routes malformed to validation queue.

ashok: migration plan: pilot backfill for last 48h, check mismatch rate, then broader 30d backfill. backfill logic: pick modal span.currency per trace when envelope missing.

leo: add feature-flag "ingest.envelope_primary_currency" for canary. emit metric ingest.envelope_currency_missing_ratio.

priya: add nightly comparator job: percent of traces where span.currency != envelope.primary_currency. alert if >0.1%.

sasha: query compatibility: planner rewrite for joins should prefer span.currency then envelope.primary_currency (coalesce). Deprecate span-only joins later.

infra-bot: scheduled feature-flag canary: ingest.envelope_primary_currency -> 2024-06-20T11:00:00Z.

maria: next actions: @leo implement ingest validator + flag, @ashok own backfill pilot, @sasha update billing pipeline FX interface, @priya add metrics and alerts. I'll draft the RFC follow-up.

leo: will send PR by EOD.

ashok: backfill pilot plan tomorrow.

sasha: FX API sketch in progress.

priya: will add alerts and runbook.

maria: if no objections by EOD I'll lock this decision and file the follow-up RFC. :thumbsup:
